snippet.title: Human's Red Destiny FULL Game Walkthrough / Playthrough - Let's Play (No Commentary)
snippet.description:
Human's Red Destiny By Roskai Okegom fangame 2D Indie Game Part 1 to Ending [Microsoft Windows]

Mikari, a normal student who recently had to change schools because of murders in her town. At her new school, she meets and makes new friends, something she has never done before in her life. 

Human's Red Destiny: https://roskai.itch.io/hrd
Developer: Roskai
Genres: Interactive Fiction, Casual
Platforms: Microsoft Windows
